apikeys.title: API Keys
apikeys.description: Create and manage access keys for API authentication.
apikeys.columns.creator: Creator
apikeys.tokenUsageChart.title: Token Usage Statistics
apikeys.dialogs.create.title: Create API Key
apikeys.dialogs.create.description: Choose what the key is for, then set a clear permission boundary for the current project.
apikeys.dialogs.create.purpose.heading: 1. Choose a key purpose
apikeys.dialogs.create.purpose.descripti: The purpose determines the key identity and permission policy. Its type cannot be switched directly after creation.
apikeys.dialogs.create.purpose.project.d: For SDKs, Codex, Claude Code, and standard inference requests. Inherits your permissions in the current project.
apikeys.dialogs.create.purpose.service.d: For CI/CD, backend services, and project automation, with explicitly assigned system permissions.
apikeys.dialogs.create.purpose.internal_: For external admin programs that call the internal API to manage subscription groups, query users, and perform other privileged operations.
apikeys.dialogs.create.basics.heading: 2. Basic information
apikeys.dialogs.create.basics.projectHin: Use a name that identifies the caller or development environment.
apikeys.dialogs.create.basics.serviceHin: Use a name that identifies the service, pipeline, or deployment environment.
apikeys.dialogs.create.basics.internal_a: Clearly identify the admin program and environment for auditing and rotation.
apikeys.dialogs.create.basics.nameDescri: This name appears in request logs and the API key list.
apikeys.dialogs.create.permissions.descr: The key can only operate within the current project's authorization and cannot expand project entitlements.
apikeys.dialogs.create.permissions.proje: Only public models subscribed to or authorized for this project
apikeys.dialogs.create.permissions.least: Select only the system permissions this service needs. Available scopes are filtered to those you can grant.
apikeys.dialogs.create.permissions.admin: This key has system administrator access
The system:admin scope cannot be removed for this purpose. Its holder can perform sensitive operations through the internal API. Use it only for controlled admin automation and store it securely.
apikeys.dialogs.create.summary.heading: Creation summary
apikeys.dialogs.create.summary.projectPe: Inherits the current user's project access permissions
apikeys.dialogs.create.summary.servicePe: Uses selected system scopes without inheriting additional permissions
apikeys.dialogs.create.summary.internal_: Always grants system:admin and is restricted to the internal admin API
apikeys.dialogs.create.summary.profileHi: After creation, use Profiles to further restrict model mappings, channels, load balancing, and quotas without expanding project entitlements.
apikeys.dialogs.edit.title: Edit API Key
apikeys.dialogs.status.enableDescription: Are you sure you want to enable API Key {{name}}?
apikeys.dialogs.status.disableDescriptio: Are you sure you want to disable API Key {{name}}?
apikeys.dialogs.archive.title: Archive API Key
apikeys.dialogs.archive.description: Are you sure you want to archive API Key {{name}}?
apikeys.dialogs.archive.warning: This action will hide the API Key from the list. You can still view archived keys by using the status filter.
apikeys.dialogs.archive.restoreDescripti: Are you sure you want to restore API Key {{name}} from archive?
apikeys.dialogs.archive.restoreInfo: The API key will be restored and visible in the active list again.
apikeys.dialogs.view.title: View API Key
apikeys.dialogs.view.description: View the complete API key details.
apikeys.dialogs.view.warning: ⚠️ Keep your API key secure and do not share it with unauthorized parties. Anyone with access to this key can make requests on your behalf.
apikeys.dialogs.rotate.title: Rotate API Key
apikeys.dialogs.rotate.description: Are you sure you want to rotate API Key {{name}}? This will generate a new key and the old key will be immediately invalidated.
apikeys.dialogs.rotate.warning: ⚠️ The old key will be immediately invalidated after rotation. Make sure to update all applications using this key. Usage statistics will be preserved.
apikeys.dialogs.view.noExamples: Usage examples are only available for user API keys
apikeys.dialogs.bulkDisable.title: Bulk Disable API Keys
apikeys.dialogs.bulkDisable.description: Are you sure you want to disable {{count}} selected API keys? This action cannot be undone.
apikeys.dialogs.bulkArchive.title: Bulk Archive API Keys
apikeys.dialogs.bulkArchive.description: Are you sure you want to archive {{count}} selected API keys? This action cannot be undone.
apikeys.dialogs.bulkEnable.title: Bulk Enable API Keys
apikeys.dialogs.bulkEnable.description: Are you sure you want to enable {{count}} selected API keys?
apikeys.dialogs.bulkEnable.warning: This action will enable all selected API keys. They will be able to make requests to the system.
apikeys.dialogs.fields.name.label: Name
apikeys.dialogs.fields.type.label: Type
apikeys.dialogs.fields.type.userDescript: User API keys inherit project scopes from the user. Suitable for personal use.
apikeys.dialogs.fields.type.serviceAccou: Service account API keys have custom scopes. Suitable for applications and services.
apikeys.dialogs.fields.scopes.label: Scopes
apikeys.dialogs.fields.scopes.descriptio: Select the permissions for this service account API key
apikeys.dialogs.fields.key.label: API Key
apikeys.validation.atLeastOneProfile: At least one profile is required
apikeys.validation.activeProfileMustExis: Active profile must exist in the profile list
apikeys.filters.filterName: Search by name or API key...
apikeys.filters.creator: Creator
apikeys.profiles.title: API Key Profiles
apikeys.profiles.description: Configure model mapping profiles for {{name}}. When an active profile has model mappings configured, the system will automatically map requested models to their target models during API requests.
apikeys.profiles.maxConcurrentRequestsDe: Limits whole requests in flight for this API key; retries and failover share one slot. Empty or 0 means unlimited.
apikeys.profiles.loadBalancerStrategyDes: Select the load balancer strategy for this profile. If not set, the system default strategy will be used.
apikeys.profiles.allowedChannelsDescript: Select channels that this profile can use. If none selected, all channels are allowed.
apikeys.profiles.legacyChannelsDescripti: These old values no longer affect request routing. Use public-model access and upstream-model mappings instead.
apikeys.profiles.allowedChannelTagsDescr: Select tags to filter channels for this profile. If none selected, tag filtering is disabled.
apikeys.profiles.excludedChannelTagsDesc: Select tags to exclude channels for this profile. If none selected, tag filtering is disabled.
apikeys.profiles.allowedModelsDescriptio: Select models that this profile can use. If none selected, all models are allowed.
apikeys.profiles.allowedGroupsDescriptio: Inherits model and channel access from the selected model groups, then intersects it with Project entitlement.
apikeys.profiles.quotaDescription: Limit this profile from unlimited usage. Limits apply only to API Key requests.
apikeys.validation.quotaAtLeastOneLimit: Quota must set at least one limit
apikeys.templates.saveDescription: Save this profile's settings as a reusable template
apikeys.templates.emptyMessage: No templates yet. Save a profile as a template first.
apikeys.templates.templateNameDuplicate: A template with this name already exists
apikeys.templates.deleteConfirmDescripti: Are you sure you want to delete the template '{{name}}'? This action cannot be undone.
apikeys.templates.legacyChannelsMigratio: Legacy channel selectors retained read-only; migrate routing before loading
apikeys.profileTemplates.title: Profile Templates
apikeys.profileTemplates.description: Manage saved profile templates that can be loaded onto API keys.
apikeys.profileTemplates.emptyHint: Save a profile as a template from an API key's profiles settings.
apikeys.profileTemplates.createDescripti: Create a new reusable profile template with model mappings, channel restrictions, and quota settings.
apikeys.access.boundary: Current Project: {{project}}. A key can only narrow the Project's subscriptions and grants.
apikeys.access.modelsDescription: Narrow access within the channels and models authorized for the current Project. Candidates are scoped by the signed-in user and Project.
apikeys.access.channelsDescription: An API key can only narrow the channels already granted to the current Project.
apikeys.access.allChannelsHint: Select no channels to allow every channel currently available to the Project.
apikeys.access.noChannelsFound: No channels are available to this Project
apikeys.access.catalogError: Could not load this Project's model catalog.
apikeys.access.groupCatalogError: The model-group catalog could not be loaded. Retry before creating the key.
apikeys.access.noGroupsFound: No enabled model groups match this search
apikeys.access.quotaDescription: Limit requests, tokens, or cost; Project wallet and subscriptions remain the upper bound.
apikeys.access.validityDescription: Immediately active and never expires by default. Local times are stored as RFC3339.
apikeys.access.intersectionNote: A key's model allowlist only intersects the current Project entitlement; it cannot expand Project access.
apikeys.access.errors.groupRequired: Select at least one enabled model group.
apikeys.access.errors.modelRequired: Select at least one public model.
apikeys.access.errors.channelRequired: Select at least one channel available to this Project.
apikeys.access.errors.invalidDates: Valid until must be later than valid from.
apikeys.access.errors.expiryInPast: Valid until must be later than the current time.
